optimizedContext.value:
# EditChange

## Rules
- Input: `name`, optional `addSpecIds`, `removeSpecIds`, `description`, optional `invalidationPolicy` (`none|surgical|downstream|global`).
- Policy-only update is persistence-worthy even if specIds/description unchanged. Changing policy MUST NOT invent drift or rewrite artifact/file canonical states.
- Missing change → `ChangeNotFoundError`. Snapshot `get(name)` MAY early-return; effective `specIds` update MUST use `ChangeRepository.mutate(name, fn)`.
- Description only (no add/remove) → update description, `invalidated: false`. No spec/desc/policy ops at all → return unchanged, `invalidated: false`, no persist, no actor.
- Removals before additions. Absent remove ID → `SpecNotInChangeError` (first missing aborts). Add idempotent (skip existing after removals).
- Newly added spec IDs: seed `change.specDependsOn` via `readPersistedDependsOn` → else `metadata.json.dependsOn` → else `[]`. MUST NOT overwrite existing `specDependsOn` entry.
- Resulting specIds identical (length+order) → return unchanged, `invalidated: false`, no persist.
- Effective specIds change: resolve actor, `mutate` → `change.updateSpecIds(specIds, actor)` (invalidates approvals + history). Then `unscaffold(change, removedSpecIds)` for `specs/<ws>/<path>/` and `deltas/<ws>/<path>/`; files removed w/ dirs; missing dirs skipped.
- Result: `{ change, invalidated }`.
- Deps: ChangeRepository, ActorResolver, `specs: ReadonlyMap<string, SpecRepository>`. Config factory via `resolveEditChangeDeps` (changes, listWorkspaces, actor, schemaProvider) only.

## Constraints
- Workspaces always derived from specIds — never modified directly
- MUST NOT validate spec IDs against filesystem — specs may not exist yet
- Actor resolved only when persistence-worthy change occurs
